package vparquet4

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/search"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb"
	cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
	tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/traceql"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/pkg/util"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/backend"
	"github.com/grafana/tempo/tempodb/encoding/common"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"testing"
)

func TestPulseDefaultNames(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT")
	if root == "" {
		t.Fatal("set PULSE_FIXTURE_ROOT")
	}
	dir := "/tmp/pulse-tempo-default-names"
	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	type Case struct {
		Dataset  string `json:"dataset"`
		Query    string `json:"query"`
		Raw      any    `json:"raw"`
		Complete any    `json:"complete"`
		V1       any    `json:"v1"`
	}
	cases := []Case{}
	for _, dataset := range []string{"promoted", "generic", "no-service"} {
		wire, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "test/fixtures/traces/tempo-filtered-names-"+dataset+".protobuf"))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		all := &tempopb.Trace{}
		if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, all); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		var rows []*Trace
		for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
			row, _ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{}, r.ScopeSpans[0].Spans[0].TraceId, &tempopb.Trace{ResourceSpans: []*tv.ResourceSpans{r}}, nil)
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
		block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t, rows)
		engine := traceql.NewEngine()
		opts := common.DefaultSearchOptions()
		for _, q := range []string{"", `{resource.service.name="worker"}`, `{span.request.kind="rpc"}`, `{resource.service.name="absent"}`, `{span.pred.a="left" && span.pred.b="right"}`} {
			raw := map[string]map[string]bool{}
			add := func(scope, key string) {
				if raw[scope] == nil {
					raw[scope] = map[string]bool{}
				}
				raw[scope][key] = true
			}
			if q == "" {
				err = block.SearchTags(context.Background(), traceql.AttributeScopeNone, func(k string, s traceql.AttributeScope) { add(s.String(), k) }, func(uint64) {}, opts)
			} else {
				fetch := traceql.NewTagNamesFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchTagsRequest, cb traceql.FetchTagsCallback) error {
					return block.FetchTagNames(ctx, r, cb, func(uint64) {}, opts)
				})
				err = engine.ExecuteTagNames(context.Background(), traceql.AttributeScopeNone, q, func(k string, s traceql.AttributeScope) bool { add(s.String(), k); return false }, fetch)
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			complete := map[string]map[string]bool{}
			for s, keys := range raw {
				complete[s] = map[string]bool{}
				for k := range keys {
					complete[s][k] = true
				}
			}
			if q != "" {
				found, err := engine.ExecuteSearch(context.Background(), &tempopb.SearchRequest{Query: q + " with (most_recent=true)", Limit: 1000, SpansPerSpanSet: 1000}, traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context, r traceql.FetchSpansRequest) (traceql.FetchSpansResponse, error) {
					return block.Fetch(ctx, r, opts)
				}))
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				ids := map[string]bool{}
				for _, tr := range found.Traces {
					if tr.SpanSet.Matched != uint32(len(tr.SpanSet.Spans)) {
						t.Fatal("clipped fixture")
					}
					for _, sp := range tr.SpanSet.Spans {
						ids[tr.TraceID+"/"+sp.SpanID] = true
					}
				}
				for _, r := range all.ResourceSpans {
					for _, ss := range r.ScopeSpans {
						for _, sp := range ss.Spans {
							if !ids[util.TraceIDToHexString(sp.TraceId)+"/"+util.SpanIDToHexString(sp.SpanId)] {
								continue
							}
							attrs := func(s string, a []*cv.KeyValue) {
								if complete[s] == nil {
									complete[s] = map[string]bool{}
								}
								for _, kv := range a {
									complete[s][kv.Key] = true
								}
							}
							attrs("resource", r.Resource.Attributes)
							attrs("span", sp.Attributes)
							if ss.Scope != nil {
								attrs("instrumentation", ss.Scope.Attributes)
							}
							for _, e := range sp.Events {
								attrs("event", e.Attributes)
							}
							for _, l := range sp.Links {
								attrs("link", l.Attributes)
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			// V1 default lookup excludes intrinsics and flattens/deduplicates scopes.
			flat := map[string]bool{}
			for _, keys := range complete {
				for k := range keys {
					flat[k] = true
				}
			}
			v1 := []string{}
			for k := range flat {
				v1 = append(v1, k)
			}
			sort.Strings(v1)
			intrinsic := map[string]bool{}
			for _, k := range search.GetVirtualIntrinsicValues() {
				intrinsic[k] = true
			}
			raw["intrinsic"] = intrinsic
			complete["intrinsic"] = intrinsic
			render := func(m map[string]map[string]bool) any {
				scopes := []*tempopb.SearchTagsV2Scope{}
				for s, keys := range m {
					if len(keys) == 0 {
						continue
					}
					tags := []string{}
					for k := range keys {
						tags = append(tags, k)
					}
					sort.Strings(tags)
					scopes = append(scopes, &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Scope{Name: s, Tags: tags})
				}
				sort.Slice(scopes, func(i, j int) bool { return scopes[i].Name < scopes[j].Name })
				return map[string]any{"scopes": scopes}
			}
			cases = append(cases, Case{dataset, q, render(raw), render(complete), map[string]any{"tagNames": v1}})
		}
	}
	for i, c := range cases {
		wire, err := os.ReadFile(fmt.Sprintf(dir+"/result-%02d.protobuf", i))
		if os.IsNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		got := &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
		want := &tempopb.SearchTagsV2Response{}
		raw, _ := json.Marshal(c.Complete)
		if err = json.Unmarshal(raw, want); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = proto.Unmarshal(wire, got); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if !proto.Equal(got, want) {
			t.Fatalf("consumer %d", i)
		}
	}
	raw, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(dir+"/oracle.json", append(raw, '\n'), 0644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
